conditions.studioCanvas: mounted; CSS display none when workspace is not studio or generative takeover is active
conditions.flowStage: mounted only when workspace is flow and generative takeover is inactive
conditions.composeStage: mounted only when workspace is compose and generative takeover is inactive
conditions.propertiesDock: unmounted for flow and generative takeover; otherwise rail shell uses dockOpen/dockCollapsed state

rail.collapsedContent: Collapsed strip replaces PropertiesDockContent; AnimatePresence may retain exiting content during transition
rail.closedButUncollapsedVisibility: zero width, zero opacity, aria-hidden, inert

floatingPanels.mountOrder: panels.order order; focused panel is last ID
floatingPanels.membership: Only IDs with an entry in panels.open mount; each uses SECTION_REGISTRY[id].render()

dock.desktopCategoryOrdering: groupsForMode order after excluded category IDs; first style group is primary
dock.mobileCategoryPolicy: Retain primary style group plus characters and animation; put primary first; other groups produce a desktop-only notice
dock.activeGroup: retain panels.activeGroup only if still in available categories; otherwise primary group; textSelected overrides to text outside compose
dock.textMountTrigger: panels.textSelected true; Add text and on-image text selection dispatch selectText; not a category icon
dock.compose: selected effect group drives active renderer; all groupsForMode(selected effect mode) mount in order; separate state bridge/override prevents a complete static control visibility claim here
dock.controlConditions: Prior descriptor conditions still apply after parent mounting; mounted does not mean every nested control is visible

deviceClassification.dimension: minimum of viewport width and height
deviceClassification.phone: dimension <= 700 and coarse primary pointer OR coarse any-pointer OR maxTouchPoints > 0
deviceClassification.tablet: dimension <= 1100 after phone test and coarse primary pointer OR hover none

entryPoints: Mobile carousel debounce (140 ms) and tile actions
stylePick.gate: isLockedMode rejects selection and opens Pro lock sheet when a matching tile is found
stylePick.sameModeSamePatch: returns false; no state assignments from this path
stylePick.sameModeChangedPatch: history snapshot; assigns only supplied tile patch; no forced style defaults call
stylePick.changedMode: history snapshot; assign renderMode; applyStyleDefaults(true); assign supplied tile patch afterward; update UI and queue render

dockHeaderSelector.gate: non-Pro user choosing isProMode tile opens lock sheet before assignments
dockHeaderSelector.assignments: assign renderMode; applyStyleDefaults(true); UI update; queue render; no tile.set patch in this selector
dockHeaderSelector.sameMode: no explicit equality guard; helper touch flags still affect writes

legacyCharactersStyleSelector.assignment: renderMode only via generic useSelect; check animation and notify UI; no immediate applyStyleDefaults call in that hook
legacyCharactersStyleSelector.laterGroundRules: 900 ms non-forced poll may enforce its narrow subset after observing the new mode

styleDefaultHelper.guard: stageHoldActive returns early without any default assignments
styleDefaultHelper.forcedFieldTargets: modeMatrix.forcedModeChangePatch; conditional touch flags and stage hold still apply
styleDefaultHelper.contrast: shader modes force 0 and arm a module-local flag; first non-shader forced application restores 100 only if current contrast is exactly 0; otherwise non-shader contrast is retained
styleDefaultHelper.fontSize: 17 for stippling and 14 for halftone only when global fontSize touch flag is false; other modes retain current size
styleDefaultHelper.parametersNotReset: No other mode-specific keys or postEffects object are assigned by this helper
styleDefaultHelper.fontSizeTouchedFlag: armed by qualifying fontSize input/change event; not cleared in the mode-change branch shown
styleDefaultHelper.nonForcedPoll: every 900 ms; coverage 100 only for mosaic,pixel,3d,lego,disco,neongrid when untouched; blend color-dodge only for pixel,lego,disco,3d when untouched; no brightness/invert/contrast/fontSize/backdrop writes in non-forced branch
styleDefaultHelper.declaredNodeDefaultsVsLiveApply: styleNodeDefaults always declares contrast 100 for non-shader nodes, but live applyStyleDefaults retains non-shader contrast except the conditional shader exit described above

dockProGate.condition: not useIsPro and isProMode(current mode; selected effect mode in compose)
dockProGate.result: controls body has inert=true and is-locked class; lock overlay appears; header selector remains outside that inert body

postEffectGates.condition: useIsLockedPostFx(effectKey) for per-effect row; Levels and Curves use separate gate keys
postEffectGates.result: locked row opens pricing/lock action instead of editing

depthVideoGate.result: Depth enable toggle dims and ignores clicks; settings mount only when depthEnabled and mode is not video; Images only for now notice appears

animationMobileGate.condition: mobile device and mode not in motionAllowed list
animationMobileGate.result: Animation panel stays mounted but shows This style moves on desktop notice in place of normal controls

backdropSolidOption.unsupportedSolidDisplay: if stored bgMode is solid and this mode does not support solid, the control displays original instead

gates.sourcePresence: Dock parent has no source presence gate. Export/crop/compare/undo controls and depth video compatibility have their own gates; nested child controls may have further unresolved source/state conditions.

unknowns: No runtime mounting, DOM, pixel, animation or screenshot verification was performed.
Rendered component mounting is proved from JSX, but CSS can hide or rearrange mounted content; CSS assets were not inspected in this pass.
Saved active group, text selection, workspace, open floating panels, entitlement, source type and local collapsed state change what is visible. Fresh mode matrix assumptions are explicit.
Compose bridge values and selected-layer/effect state are not fully expanded; compose visibility remains conditional.
Four original candidates remain parametric rather than fully enumerated: three palette-helper candidates and one numeric draft helper.
Mode-specific control conditions from the original ledger are preserved; parent reachability does not resolve all descendant conditions.
Generic preset action and randomizeAscii side effects are described only to the extent of directly visible assignments/calls.
Other selection entry points such as recipe/history/demo restoration may mutate broader state and are outside the traced tile/header/legacy selector paths.

mobileShell.canvas: Canvas remains mounted; mob-stage is-hidden class applies in Generative mode

styleCarousel.selection: nearest centered tile on scroll, debounced 140 ms, calls applyStylePick; direct locked tile click opens lock sheet

bottomActions.upload: hidden image/*,video/* input; chosen file passes to handleFile
bottomActions.library: toggleDrawer; asset library component is lazy mounted after boot or first drawer activation
bottomActions.export: disabled without source; opens export modal using button bounds
